fields.label: Capture ID
fields.description: Opaque id (oacap_<hex>) handed to the browser after an OAuth token exchange. The DocType name IS this id (autoname field:capture_id), so it is the only handle the SPA ever holds - the minted provider token never leaves the server.

fields.label: Owner User
fields.description: The user who began (and may consume) this sign-in. consume/list are gated on this equalling frappe.session.user so one System Manager can never consume a peer's pending capture.

fields.label: Upstream
fields.description: cliproxy pool upstream ('openai' | 'xai' | 'kimi'), the value the pool subscription account row is stored under.

fields.label: Openclaw Provider
fields.description: The openclaw_provider key (used only to look up the provider's token-revocation endpoint on expiry/cancel).

fields.label: Provider Subject Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the provider's STABLE subject (accountId, else email) - the idempotency key for folding two captures of the same account without storing the raw subject. Empty when the provider returns no stable subject (device-code Kimi).

fields.label: Safe Label
fields.description: Non-secret display label (the account email, or a synthesized 'Kimi <ref-tail>'). Returned to the browser; never a token.

fields.label: Account Email
fields.description: The account email the sign-in reported, for display parity with the pre-capture flow. Empty for device-code providers. Never written to logs/telemetry.

fields.label: Account Ref
fields.description: The SUB_<hex> per-account ref the pool subscription row keys on (^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,64}$). Stable across the capture's life so save_llm_pool can fold the consumed blob onto the right account row.

fields.label: Nonce Hash
fields.description: sha256 of the originating OAuth nonce, for audit correlation only (the nonce itself is single-use and already burned by the time this row exists).

fields.label: Encrypted OAuth Blob
fields.description: The minted openclaw OAuth blob (JSON). A Password field, so it lives ENCRYPTED in Frappe's __Auth store - the table column holds only a mask, never plaintext, and it is never returned by any read endpoint. Erased (set blank -> __Auth row dropped) once consumed into a desired-state save, or after the expiry sweeper has revoked the provider token.

fields.label: Expires At
fields.description: When this capture stops being resumable. The sweeper revokes the provider token and erases the ciphertext past this instant.

fields.label: Consumed At
fields.description: Set by the atomic once-only consume claim (a conditional UPDATE ... WHERE consumed_at IS NULL). A non-null value means the blob was adopted into a desired-state save and the ciphertext erased; a second consume of the same capture claims zero rows and is refused.

fields.label: Consumed By Operation
fields.description: The admin LLM-apply operation id that adopted this capture (audit trail). Recorded after the save returns the durable descriptor.

fields.label: Revocation State
fields.description: Lifecycle of the minted provider token: pending (live, resumable) -> consumed (adopted into a save; the container now owns it) | revoked (sweeper revoked it) | unsupported (provider has no revocation endpoint we can call; ciphertext erased, token left to expire) | failed (a transient revoke error; the sweeper retries, then alerts).

fields.label: Revocation Attempts
fields.description: How many times the sweeper has tried to revoke this token, so a persistently-failing provider is bounded and then alerted rather than retried forever.
